name: @natlang/runbook-engine
description: Execute Markdown runbooks with safety gates: a step DAG, risk decisions before effects, confirmation for destructive steps, exactly-once effects and health checks.

runbook-engine.description: Execute a Markdown runbook specification from a JSON file or stdin and output the ExecutionReport as JSON.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Path to a JSON file containing { markdown, confirmedStepIds?, healthByStep?, options? }.
